requirement: Python color, contour and quiver implementations
evidence: Figs. 18-20, 27; scripts/build_scivis.py. Four real gridMET fields; no synthetic weather values.

requirement: Scalar animations with 5-10 time instances
evidence: Three supplied GIFs, each with eight frames: fixed-scale temperature, daily-scale temperature and contours. images/scivis/.

requirement: NetworkX or Gephi; at least three layouts and interactions
evidence: NetworkX Spring, Spectral and Circular; Fig. 1. web/network.html supports layout switching, threshold, country search, selection, pan and zoom.

requirement: JavaScript parallel coordinates with edge bundling and interaction
evidence: Figs. 4-5; web/app.js and output/pcp_changes/app.js. Bundling, real pointer brushing, axis ordering and country inspection are tested. Bundles use explicit adoption groups, not inferred clusters.

requirement: JavaScript zoomable treemaps
evidence: Figs. 9-10; web/treemap.js. Zoom/back, breadcrumbs and two complete hierarchy remodels retain the same 184 country leaves.

requirement: Python horizon and ridgeline visualizations
evidence: Figs. 14-17; scripts/build_temporal_figures.py. Two horizon variations and two ridgeline variations.

requirement: gridMET and a contiguous three-month interval
evidence: July 1-September 30, 2023. The 92-day cache and separate eight-date cache retain the selected gridMET variables and acquisition provenance.

requirement: Explain both the period and temporal sampling choice
evidence: Data and preparation: summer-to-autumn heat/cooling/rain timing; documented 2023 Southwest heat context; uniform 13-day spacing with endpoints, contrasted with random gaps. Full-period claims use all 92 dates.

requirement: Team slice selected through the TAs form; first-come policy
evidence: The supplied files cannot prove registration or uniqueness in the TAs form. Team must confirm its registered slice. This is an administrative check, not a plot feature.

requirement: Extract vs and th for wind; other variables for scalars
evidence: vs maps to wind_speed and th to wind_from_direction in build_scivis.py; tmmx maps to air_temperature and pr to precipitation_amount. Source masks/packing are decoded; source Kelvin converts once to Celsius.

requirement: Build network, multivariate and hierarchy data from A1
evidence: Three preserved OWID/ITU extracts in data/raw/. Preprocessing outer-joins on entity/code/year, excludes 823 aggregate rows and retains 12,564 country-year rows without imputation.

requirement: Discuss network difficulty with instructor before deadline
evidence: User-supplied instructor reply approves a derived similarity network and advises distribution-based filtering. Report attributes guidance once; P95 is explicitly the team choice. The email itself is not published.

requirement: Submit report, images folder and codebase
evidence: DAS732_A2_Report.pdf; images/report/Fig1.png-Fig31.png; data/, scripts/, web/, requirements.txt and launcher. Submission is self-contained without a Git remote.

requirement: Captioned report images and image-specific inferences
evidence: All 31 figures sets have a key-result caption, concise reading guide, evidence-based interpretation and numbered action takeaway. Full question/rationale guides are included in figures.html; common caveats are centralized.

requirement: High-resolution assessment images with report indices
evidence: Numbered PNGs and available matching SVGs in images/report/. Raw plot exports also remain at their source paths for exact regeneration.

requirement: Titles, legends, axes and other necessary text
evidence: Rendered report and full-resolution exports reviewed. Units, thresholds, cohort/sample sizes and scale keys are included where relevant; non-Cartesian views use appropriate labels and legends.

requirement: Complete high-resolution GUI screenshots
evidence: Appendices A1-A3 embed complete high-resolution browser captures with controls. images/gui/ and interactions.html retain originals and extra states; the PNG charts are identified as analytical exports.

requirement: README for implementation
evidence: Root README contains a local launch route, dependencies, data preprocessing, transformations, staged reproduction and validation commands. web/README.md explains interactions.

requirement: Video demo is not required
evidence: The supplied PDF explicitly says a video demo is not required. Old slides, scripts and unrecorded video materials are excluded from the core submission.

requirement: Professional report; appropriate references encouraged
evidence: 27-page IEEE-style report, readable captions and eleven cited references including gridMET, OWID, NetworkX, D3, Gephi and ContourPy/Marching Squares.

requirement: Each student implements at least one SciVis and one InfoVis task
evidence: The assigned responsibilities satisfy the domain rule: Parikshith network/PCP + color; Sindhoor horizon/ridgeline + contours; Varshith treemap + quiver. Actual independent implementation is a team attestation, not verified by counts.

requirement: Combined outcome proportional to team strength
evidence: All specified visualization families and experiments are included for the three-person team, plus supporting analyses addressing the main question.

requirement: Report clearly states contributions
evidence: Named task-responsibility table; Person A/B/C and video duties removed. Figure allocation is 12/10/10. Assigned responsibilities must match actual independent work.

requirement: No joint task ownership; no two students do the same task
evidence: The assigned type ownership is distinct and all 31 figures have one assigned name. Shared preprocessing and reuse of method outputs are separated from task ownership. Confirm that actual work matches this table.

requirement: Marching Squares and/or filled contours; explain rationale
evidence: Fig. 20; independent 16-case code, both saddle-center resolutions and missing-cell handling. All 32 case checks pass; real-grid segments match ContourPy at four levels. Lines/filled bands serve threshold/regional reading tasks.

requirement: Continuous/discrete/logarithmic mappings and palettes
evidence: Fig. 18 compares continuous/discrete sequential, linear/log rain, a turbo baseline and a meaningful zero-centered departure map. Fig. 22 uses diverging differences. Quantity changes and zero-rain handling are explicit.

requirement: Global versus local extrema across timesteps
evidence: Fig. 19 plus fixed/daily-scale GIFs; identical colors under different extrema can represent different temperatures. Global bounds cover the eight sampled fields, not every day in the interval.

requirement: Quiver sampling/length comparison OR streamline experiment
evidence: Option 6a: Fig. 27 compares 4/12 display-cell steps and speed-proportional versus same-length arrows. vs/th conversion, map bearing and 5 m/s key are explicit. Streamlines are optional and not implemented.

requirement: Node-link layouts; node filtering optional
evidence: Three layouts in Fig. 1 and the live UI. Optional region and hide-isolate node filters are implemented in addition to required edge-threshold interaction.

requirement: PCP must have axis reordering and/or brushing
evidence: Both are implemented and exercised through actual pointer/axis controls. Bundling changes paths while preserving measured values at the axes.

requirement: Treemap hierarchy remodels; spatial partition optional
evidence: Region -> country and adoption band -> region -> country. Optional squarified versus slice-and-dice selector preserves totals and hierarchy. Figs. 9-10 plus UI evidence.

requirement: At least two horizon and two ridgeline variations
evidence: Horizon: selected country series and regional medians (Figs. 14-15). Ridgeline: global yearly and regional yearly distributions (Figs. 16-17). Fixed cohorts and 0-100 scales avoid changing sample definitions.

requirement: 4 points: all experiments and complete deliverables
evidence: Every compulsory experiment maps to a figure, implementation or GIF above. Folder integrity and local runtime links are checked; external registration and actual ownership remain separate checks.

requirement: 8 points: valid inference for dataset space/time
evidence: Numerical verifiers recompute edges, distributions, paired changes, monthly weather, rainfall concentration and run lengths. Similarity is not a physical cable; observational associations are not causal claims.

requirement: 8 points: useful complex inferences from visualization
evidence: 32 question/evidence/inference/takeaway sequences connect profiles, paired trajectories, within-group variation, full-month versus endpoint change, daily order and joint occurrence.

requirement: 10 points: preprocessing and transformations
evidence: Separate preprocess_data.py; raw extracts, region lookup, cache metadata and SHA-256 audit. Missingness/cohort rules, masks, temperature units, wind convention, subsampling and area weights are documented.
